<description>
Part of #36833.
Based on #36919; review from `p2p: add staletip message type and payload`.

This adds the [BIP 332](https://github.com/bitcoin/bips/blob/master/bip-0332.md) `staletip` message, negotiated through the BIP 434 `BIP332` feature. With `-staletips=headers`, the node announces the stale tips it tracks and tracks the ones its peers announce. Only headers are relayed.

### Key changes

* New `staletip` message type and payload.
* Add a `StaleTipRelayManager`, which holds the relay policy.
* With `-staletips=headers`, the node advertises `BIP332` (with `prefers_blocks=false`) and relays only with peers that advertise it too.
* Stale tips learned from peers are tracked, and listed by `getchaintips` with `staletips_only`:

  Sample output

  A node that learned of a stale tip only from a peer's `staletip` message:

  ```
  $ bitcoin-cli -named getchaintips staletips_only=true
  [
    {
      "height": 111,
      "hash": "6377f9037ff98cb738f676bee62d1931adf41c2cdb00e0148b8d5fbf6161807d",
      "branchlen": 1,
      "fork_point": "24bed510a58473fb7ac8cd0f48bb25d75cf9848f00a62be08721b64cea6acd20",
      "status": "headers-only"
    }
  ]
  ```

* `getnetworkinfo` gets a `localfeatures` field, listing the BIP 434 features the node advertises.

  Sample output

  ```
  $ bitcoin-cli getnetworkinfo
  {
    ...
    "localfeatures": {
      "BIP332": {
        "prefers_blocks": false
      }
    },
    ...
  }
  ```

* `getpeerinfo` gets a `features` field, listing the BIP 434 features each peer advertises.

  Sample output

  ```
  $ bitcoin-cli getpeerinfo
  [
    {
      "id": 1,
      ...
      "features": {
        "BIP332": {
          "prefers_blocks": false
        }
      },
      ...
    }
  ]
  ```
</description>

<commits>
97512c7963 validation: add AcceptedStaleTip notification

Notify validation interface listeners when a header or block is
accepted that is not on the active chain and has no more work than
the active tip. BIP 332 stale-tip tracking, added in later commits,
uses this.

Headers from one ProcessNewBlockHeaders() call are coalesced into one
notification for the last new header. A block is notified again when
its data is stored.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

d567ff5de9 staletips: add bounded stale-tip tracker

Add StaleTipTracker, which keeps up to MAX_ADVERTISED_STALETIPS
recent stale tips that are eligible for relay under BIP 332. When
full, it evicts the tip with the least work.

Add BlockTree to test/util/blocktree.h so later tests can share it.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

00660cb87a staletips: apply test-network tracking policies

Test networks are less protected by proof of work, so BIP 332
recommends stricter stale-tip policies there. On signet, only track
tips whose block has been validated, and one header variant per
block. On testnet3 and testnet4, only track tips with a difficulty
of at least about 1,000,000.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

01f8a8f8f3 staletips: seed tracker from the block index

The tracker is not persisted, so add SeedFromBlockIndex() to rebuild
it at startup from the eligible stale tips in the block index.
Candidates go through AddStaleTip(), so the same policies apply as
at runtime.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

c497ae1291 init: add -staletips option

Add -staletips=<mode> to opt in to BIP 332 stale-tip relay. For now
'headers' only enables stale-tip tracking, which the next commits
add; later PRs add relay behind the same mode.

Make the PeerManager ApplyArgsManOptions() return util::Result, like
the other ApplyArgsManOptions() helpers, so an invalid mode is
reported at startup.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

9cf113f3cc net_processing: track local stale tips

When -staletips is enabled, track the stale tips this node learns
about.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

61c349f95a rpc: add max_depth and fork_point to getchaintips

Add an optional max_depth argument that limits getchaintips to tips at
most that many blocks below the active tip, and report fork_point for
each tip that is not on the active chain.

This lets callers find recent forks without listing every old stale
branch on mainnet or walking back each branch to its fork point.

4173d9332c rpc: report tracked stale tips in getchaintips

Add a staletips_only argument to getchaintips that lists only the
recent stale tips the node tracks with -staletips, taken from the
stale-tip tracker.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

10fa8b7a08 doc: add release note for stale-tip tracking

882eaaf466 p2p: add staletip message type and payload

Define the BIP 332 staletip message. Move MAX_STALETIP_HEADERS from
the tracker to the message header, as the limit comes from the
message format.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

00237c9647 refactor: move stale-tip tracker into StaleTipRelayManager

Add StaleTipRelayManager to hold the stale-tip relay state and policy,
starting with the tracker that PeerManager has owned so far. It
requires cs_main instead of a lock of its own, as it holds CBlockIndex
pointers.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

3580cd51dc staletips: build staletip messages for tracked forks

Add MakeStaleTipMessage() to build the staletip message announcing a
tracked fork. Make HasAncestor() public so it can check the fork.

eaa62d00de net_processing: negotiate staletip relay via BIP 434

Advertise the BIP 434 stale-tip relay feature when -staletips is
enabled, and record the feature data of peers that advertise it.
Malformed feature data is ignored. On signet, set prefers_blocks, as
stale tips there can only be validated with their blocks.

Add NetFeatures to hold the recognized BIP 434 features, so that their
data is parsed and serialized in one place.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

1936b06089 rpc: report BIP 434 features in getnetworkinfo and getpeerinfo

Add "localfeatures" to getnetworkinfo and "features" to getpeerinfo,
listing the BIP 434 features the node and each peer advertise, with
their decoded data.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

7d352e13dd refactor: add window param to GetAntiDoSWorkThreshold

Name the 144-block anti-DoS buffer ANTI_DOS_WORK_WINDOW and let
callers pass a different window. A later commit checks inbound
staletip messages against a wider window.

e8e7377114 net_processing: validate and track inbound staletip messages

Accept staletip messages from peers that negotiated the feature, and
add their headers and track the tip if they pass validation and
policy checks.

Use STALETIP_RECENT_WINDOW for the work threshold rather than the
default 144 blocks, so stale tips that peers may advertise are not
discarded.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

2418e2aa8a net_processing: fetch higher-work blocks announced via staletip

If a staletip branch has more work than our active tip, for example
because we are behind, handle it as for a headers message: update the
peer's header state and request the blocks through the direct-fetch
path. Only do so when the peer set have_block, as otherwise it has not
said it can serve the blocks.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

10b9f3ecd4 net_processing: announce active tips for stale-tip relay

Queue an inv for our new active tip to peers that negotiated staletip,
even when the normal announcement is skipped because the peer already
has the header. A peer only sends us a staletip message whose fork
point it knows we have, which it infers from the blocks we announce,
so BIP 332 asks nodes to always announce their active tip.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

13d0ffb7e2 net_processing: relay stale-tip announcements

Announce each eligible stale tip once to negotiated peers that have its
fork point but not the tip. On signet, wait until we can serve the
block, which peers need to validate the tip.

Remember per peer the tips it announced to us, so we don't echo them
back. Remember the tips we announced to a peer for as long as they stay
tracked, so a reorg doesn't make us announce them again.

Co-authored-by: woltx <94266259+w0xlt@users.noreply.github.com>
Co-authored-by: Anthony Towns <aj@erisian.com.au>

9343e63c44 net_processing: don't punish peers for invalid stale-branch blocks

BIP 332 lets a peer serve blocks on a stale branch it never connected,
so their scripts may be unchecked. Remember which tips a peer announced
with have_block set, and, as for BIP 152 compact blocks, don't punish
it for a block on such a branch that only fails once connected, or that
already turned out invalid, through an ancestor, when it arrives.

Still punish it for a block failing the checks done before storing it,
as the peer must have passed them to store the block.

de7a810827 doc: add BIP 332 to bips.md and release note
</commits>

+std::optional<StaleTipFeature> StaleTipFeature::Parse(std::span<const std::byte> data)
+{
+    if (data.size() != 1) return std::nullopt;
+    const auto value{std::to_integer<uint8_t>(data[0])};
+    if (value > 1) return std::nullopt;
+    return StaleTipFeature{.prefers_blocks = value == 1};
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,17 @@
+P2P and network changes
+-----------------------
+
+- With `-staletips=headers`, the node negotiates stale-tip relay (BIP 332)
+  with peers that advertise the BIP 434 `BIP332` feature. It announces the
+  recent stale tips it tracks to those peers, tracks the stale tips they
+  announce, and requests the block of an announced tip that has more work
+  than its active tip. A peer that serves an invalid block on a stale
+  branch it announced is not disconnected for it, since BIP 332 lets peers
+  serve such blocks without having validated them. (#36920)
+
+Updated RPCs
+------------
+
+- `getnetworkinfo` has a new `localfeatures` field and `getpeerinfo` a new
+  `features` field, listing the BIP 434 features the node and each peer
+  advertise, with their decoded data. (#36920)

@@ -0,0 +1,18 @@
+New settings
+------------
+
+- A new `-staletips=<mode>` option tracks recent stale chain tips for
+  stale-tip relay (BIP 332). The modes are `none` (the default) and
+  `headers`. (#36919)
+
+Updated RPCs
+------------
+
+- `getchaintips` has a new optional `options` argument. Its `max_depth`
+  option limits the result to tips at most that many blocks below the
+  active tip, and its `staletips_only` option lists only the recent stale
+  tips tracked with `-staletips`. The options can also be passed as named
+  arguments. (#36919)
+
+- `getchaintips` reports `fork_point`, the block where the branch
+  connects to the active chain, for each non-active tip. (#36919)

+// file COPYING or http://www.opensource.org/licenses/mit-license.php.
+
+#include <staletipmessage.h>
+
+#include <uint256.h>
+
+#include <vector>
+
+std::vector<CBlockHeader> StaleTipMessage::DecompressHeaders() const
+{
+    std::vector<CBlockHeader> decompressed;
+    decompressed.reserve(headers.size());
+
+    uint256 prev_hash{fork_point};
+    for (const auto& compressed : headers) {
+        CBlockHeader header;
+        header.nVersion = compressed.version;
+        header.hashPrevBlock = prev_hash;
+        header.hashMerkleRoot = compressed.merkle_root;
+        header.nTime = compressed.time;
+        header.nBits = compressed.bits;
+        header.nNonce = compressed.nonce;
+        decompressed.push_back(header);
+        prev_hash = decompressed.back().GetHash();
+    }
+
+    return decompressed;
+}

+    roundtrip_stream >> roundtrip;
+    assert(roundtrip == data);
+}
